tools.name: ai.connection.test
tools.title: Test the AI service
tools.description: Asks the saved AI service one short question and reports its answer. Changes no setting.

tools.name: ai.settings.save
tools.title: Set up the AI service
tools.description: Fills in and saves the AI settings: the kind of service, its address, the model and whether people are offered the assistant. Never a key: when the service needs one, the operator pastes it into the Key field themselves, and an empty key keeps the one already saved.

kind.description: openai for any OpenAI-compatible address (Ollama too), anthropic for Anthropic's API.

endpoint.description: The service's address, starting with https:// or http://.

assistant.description: Whether to offer the assistant to people on this server.

tools.name: keys.author
tools.title: Make the missing service keys
tools.description: Gives every service that has no key yet its own key, made at random by the server. Services that already have one are left alone.

tools.name: keys.list
tools.title: See each service's keys
tools.description: Shows each service's keys on the Keys page: where each came from, where it is kept and whether it is in use. Never a key's bytes. Changes nothing.

tools.name: keys.replace
tools.title: Replace a service key
tools.description: Replaces one service's key with a new one made at random, or read from an environment variable or a file on the server. Its secrets are sealed again under the new key and the old key is destroyed. A key to paste is never passed here: the operator pastes it on the Keys page themselves.

from.description: Where the new key comes from. Default: random.

path.description: For file: the full path of the file on the server.

tools.name: screen.go
tools.title: Open a page of the admin panel
tools.description: Opens a page of the admin panel on the operator's screen, such as /shippin/admin/keys, so they see where the work happens. Only admin panel pages. Changes nothing.

annotations.title: Open a page of the admin panel

tools.name: screen.read
tools.title: See the operator's screen
tools.description: Says which admin page the operator has open, its heading, and the actions that can run there. Changes nothing.
